ja: 新しい方法のほうがずっと速いです。
en: The new way is much faster.
alternatives: The new way is a lot faster.
The new method is much quicker.
point: 比較級を強めるのは very ではなく much や a lot

ja: 私があの時確認していれば、今ごろ慌てていないのに。
en: If I'd checked then, I wouldn't be scrambling now.
alternatives: If I'd double-checked, I wouldn't be scrambling right now.
If I'd checked then, I wouldn't be panicking now.
point: if 節は過去完了、今の結果は wouldn't be -ing

ja: あと二日あれば、私たちは終わるのに。
en: If we had two more days, we'd finish.
alternatives: With two more days, we could finish.
Given two more days, we'd be done.
point: 現実と違う仮定なので had と we'd を使う

ja: 新人がいつ来るか、もう聞きましたか？
en: Have you heard when the new hire starts?
alternatives: Have you found out when the new hire starts?
Do you know yet when the new hire starts?
point: when 以下は疑問文の語順にせず the new hire starts

ja: リリース前にこのバグに気づけばよかったです。
en: I wish I'd caught this bug before release.
alternatives: I wish I'd noticed this bug before release.
If only I'd spotted this bug before release.
point: 過去の後悔は wish の後を had + 過去分詞にする

ja: 企画書、もう完成しています。
en: The proposal is already finished.
alternatives: The proposal is already done.
The proposal is finished already.
point: 「もう〜している」は already を入れて be 動詞＋finished

ja: 私が早く相談していれば、遅れは防げました。
en: If I'd asked sooner, we'd have avoided delays.
alternatives: If I'd consulted you sooner, we'd have avoided delays.
If I'd asked earlier, we could've avoided the delay.
point: 過去の仮定は If I had 〜, would have 過去分詞

ja: 今、プレゼンの資料を作っています。
en: I'm working on the presentation now.
alternatives: I'm preparing the presentation now.
I'm putting the presentation together now.
point: 「〜しているところ」は現在進行形 I'm ~ing

ja: 数字が怪しいので、後輩に確認してもらっています。
en: The numbers look fishy, so I'm having a junior check.
alternatives: The numbers seem off, so I've got a junior checking them.
The figures look off, so I'm getting a junior to check.
point: have＋人＋動詞の原形。to は付けない

ja: 営業は締め切りの延長を検討中です。
en: Sales is thinking about extending the deadline.
alternatives: Sales is considering extending the deadline.
Sales is thinking of pushing the deadline back.
point: about や consider の後ろは to 不定詞ではなく -ing 形

ja: 取引先は、部品が遅れると言いました。
en: They said the parts would be late.
alternatives: The supplier said the parts would be late.
They told us the parts would be late.
point: 言われた内容も過去に合わせて will ではなく would

ja: 遅れるなら、早く言ってくれればよかったのに。
en: You should've told me about the delay sooner.
alternatives: You should have let me know sooner.
You should have given me a heads-up sooner.
point: 「〜すべきだったのに」は should have + 過去分詞

ja: この件、もう部長に相談しましたか？
en: Have you run this by the manager yet?
alternatives: Have you talked to the manager about this yet?
Have you checked with the manager yet?
point: 「相談する」は run ~ by で言える

ja: 見積もりが届いたら、すぐ共有しますね。
en: I'll share the quote once it arrives.
alternatives: As soon as it arrives, I'll share it.
I'll send you the quote once it arrives.
point: when の後は未来のことでも現在形 arrives にする

ja: 課長、アドバイスをもらえますか？
en: Could you give me some advice?
alternatives: Could I ask for some advice?
Can you give me some advice?
point: advice は数えられないので an advice や advices にしない

ja: これ、いつまでに終えればいいですか？
en: When should I finish this?
alternatives: When should I finish this by?
When do I have to finish this?
point: 「〜すればいい」は should で助言や指示を求める

ja: 気になるのは、先方がまだ返事をくれないことです。
en: What worries me is that the client hasn't replied.
alternatives: What concerns me is that the client hasn't responded yet.
I'm worried because the client hasn't gotten back to us.
point: 「気になるのは」は What worries me is that で始める

ja: 納品は来週に延期されました。
en: The delivery was pushed to next week.
alternatives: Delivery has been postponed until next week.
The delivery was moved to next week.
point: 納品が主語なので was pushed と受け身にする

ja: 先方は承認しただけでなく、前倒しまで希望しました。
en: Not only did they approve, they wanted an early start.
alternatives: Not only did they sign off, they wanted to start early.
They not only approved it, they wanted an early start.
point: Not only の後は did＋主語＋原形の語順

ja: サーバーが落ちて、200人が締め出されました。
en: The server went down, locking out 200 users.
alternatives: The server crashed, and 200 users got locked out.
The server went down and locked out 200 users.
point: 結果は , locking out 〜 の分詞でつなげる

ja: 私、宛先を間違えて送ったかもしれません。
en: I might have sent it to the wrong address.
alternatives: I may have sent it to the wrong address.
I might have gotten the address wrong.
point: 過去の推量は might have + 過去分詞

ja: テストは途中ですが、金曜には間に合います。
en: Although testing isn't done, we'll be ready by Friday.
alternatives: Testing isn't finished, but we'll be ready by Friday.
Even though testing isn't done, we'll finish by Friday.
point: although の後に but は重ねない

ja: 原因を調べて、またご連絡します。
en: I'll look into it and get back to you.
alternatives: I'll investigate the cause and get back to you.
I'll check into it and let you know.
point: 「調べる」は look into、「連絡する」は get back to

ja: 先週は苦戦しましたが、今はもう解決しました。
en: We struggled last week, but it's fixed now.
alternatives: Last week was rough, but we've solved it now.
We had trouble last week, but we've fixed it.
point: last week は過去形、今の状態は現在形か現在完了

ja: すみません、注文は全部さばけません。
en: Sorry, we can't handle all the orders.
alternatives: Sorry, we can't process every order.
Sorry, we can't get through all the orders.
point: 「注文をさばく」は handle the orders
